# Draft:Governments of the Second Spanish Republic

During the Second Spanish Republic there were 26 different governments in place by 11 different prime ministers.
There were two governments during the provisional or constituent period, four during the Reformist Biennium, 9 during the Radical-Cedist Biennium, 4 Popular Front governments and 7 wartime cabinets.
